title: PX4 PARAMETERS · INSPECT TO VERIFY
subtitle: Choose aircraft → inspect → edit → review → apply once → read the receipt
steps: Choose aircraft, Refresh, then find a parameter. Reading and inspecting do not change PX4.
Select Edit value. Check the units and reference details. Review change creates a draft, not a write.
Choose Apply targets, then Prepare review. Check the aircraft and exact current → proposed values before Apply.
Verified means the readback matched. For an unconfirmed result, use Check receipt; do not submit another write to investigate.
Profiles and QGC imports enter the same target/difference review. Loading a file or profile never applies it automatically.
footer: Synthetic SITL illustrations, not recommended flight tuning. Keep aircraft safely grounded/disarmed for maintenance. Reboot is a separate deliberate action.
